method: ffmpeg decode f32, per-window mean subtraction; Hann FFT with 8x zero padding and log-parabolic peak interpolation; normalized AC autocorrelation at nearest-sample nominal periods. Windows selected in the second complete diagnostic cycle after initial capture settling.
limitations: ASUS4KPRO capture processing adds DC offset, startup settling and transients; settled AC measurements do not establish bit-exact digital silence or exact DAC levels.
No physical AY chip measurement; frequency comparison is against original3.25MHz CPU/2 AY relationship.
Window timing is relative to capture start, inferred from observed diagnostic spectral sequence; no synchronized CPU phase-marker trace on hardware.
Hardware audio verifies representative envelope behavior, not every shape/edge case; standalone simulation tests cover those separately.
